narr: A typical summertime pattern prevailed with scattered afternoon thunderstorms across the tri-state region. A few storms produced heavy rain with localized flooding.
ev: Water was reported over the roadway near the intersection of County Road 14 and County Road 360. A ham radio operator reported 3.54 inches of rain in a short period of time.
Flooding was reported on Beck Ave between 11th Street and Highway 98.
lsr: FLOODING REPORTED AT CR 14 AND CR 360. WATER OVER ROADWAY. HAM RADIO OPERATOR NEAR MADISON REPORTED 3.54 INCHES OF RAIN IN HIS GAUGE.
FLOODING ON BECK AVE BETWEEN 11TH STREET AND HIGHWAY 98.
